title: HR & Training Coordinator
company: Pure Resourcing Solutions Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are looking for an organised and proactive HR & Training Coordinator to join a HR team within an Engineering company in Chelmsford. You will be supporting with training administration, compliance and employee records.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with administration or HR experience who enjoys working in a fast paced environment and managing multiple priorities.

Benefits
- Starting salary between 30-35k depending on experience.
- 25 days holiday + BH.
- Hybrid working.
- Working hours 08:30-17:00 Monday-Friday.
- Exposure to training, compliance and people-focused projects.
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities.

Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate employee training bookings and maintain training schedules.
- Update and manage training records, certificates and compliance data.
- Monitor training requirements and highlight upcoming expiries or gaps.
- Liaise with managers and external training providers to arrange courses.
- Support onboarding activities, including project-related requirements.
- Produce training reports and maintain accurate HR administration records.

Experience & Skills Required
- Previous administration experience, ideally within HR or training.
- Strong organisational skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Able to liaise with external training providers.
- Confident using Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and work to deadlines.
- Professional communication skills working with the team in mind.
- A proactive, flexible attitude with a willingness to learn.

If you are a highly organised administrator looking to build or further your career within HR and training, we would love to hear from you.

title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator (Maternity Cover - 9 to 12 Months)

Location: Chelmsford

Hours: 8:30-5 PM Monday- Friday

Pay: 15- 19.48ph + Holiday, Pension and Adecco benefits

Start date: Immediately after successful interview

Are you an organised, proactive HR professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment? We're looking for an HR Administrator to join our clients friendly and supportive HR team of 7, providing essential support to employees across their manufacturing business.

This is a varied and hands-on role where you'll be the first point of contact for HR queries, managing the HR helpdesk and phone lines while delivering a high level of customer service to both employees and managers. You'll support the full employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, inductions, maintaining employee records, generating HR reports, and assisting with updating HR policies and procedures.

We're looking for someone who can work on their own initiative, take a proactive approach to problem-solving, and confidently manage multiple priorities. You'll be comfortable building relationships across the business and providing accurate guidance on HR processes and policies.

Essential Requirements:
- Previous HR administration experience within a busy HR environment
- Strong working knowledge of Workday
- Experience managing employee data and producing HR reports
- Knowledge of onboarding and offboarding processes
- CIPD Level 5 qualified or currently working towards
- Excellent communication, organisational and administration skills
- Ability to work independently and use initiative

About You:

You'll be someone who enjoys being part of a social and collaborative team, knows when to roll up your sleeves and get stuck into the workload, but also appreciates having fun along the way. If you're professional, approachable, and passionate about delivering excellent HR support, we'd love to hear from you.

Why work for Adecco?
- Candidate of the month incentives
- Boost rewards - discount vouchers and collect points to spend!
- Support programmes
- Eye Care vouchers
- Competitive pension scheme

title: Recruitment Administration Assistant
description:

Harlow - Monday to Thursday: 8:00am - 5:00pm Friday: 8:00am - 4:00pm

Ensuring all candidate compliance documentation is completed and maintained accurately on the database

Screening candidates and sourcing new applicants through job boards, social media platforms and branch walk-ins

Reviewing applications and registrations to identify suitable candidates for vacancies

Processing weekly payroll for temporary workers

Setting up new starters and completing onboarding administration

Assisting with client servicing and providing candidate support during periods of annual leave and staff absence

Maintaining accurate records and supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the branch

What We're Looking For

Strong administrative and organisational skills

Excellent attention to detail

Confident communication skills, both written and verbal

Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment

Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office

Previous administration, customer service or recruitment experience would be advantageous but is not essential

A positive, proactive and team-focused attitude

What We Offer

Competitive salary

Early finish every Friday

Ongoing training and development

Supportive team environment

Career progression opportunities within a well-established recruitment business

If you enjoy working in a busy office environment, have a keen eye for detail and are passionate about delivering excellent customer service, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to join Berry Recruitment and start your recruitment career with a market-leading agency.

We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. All applicants will be considered on the basis of their skills, experience, qualifications and ability to perform the role, and no applicant will be treated less favourably because of a protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010.
